name: ZwZ2 and ZoomGain (fine-grained perception RL models)

lineage.base_model: ZwZ2: Qwen3.5 (9B confirmed on the card; 4B and 27B siblings exist); ZoomGain: 4B and 9B
lineage.how_derived: GRPO without an SFT stage on about 20K verified multi-region questions built from SA-1B images (ZwZ2, EvidenceConnect); ZoomGain builds questions about full images from details visible only when zoomed in

purpose: Teach vision-language models to connect visual evidence across regions and read fine detail in full images without zoom tools at inference (cards).

license.name: not stated
license.notes: No license field in the ZwZ2-9B, ZoomGain-9B repos; the base Qwen3.5 models are Apache-2.0 but the fine-tune's terms are not given.

pc-12gb.notes: 18.82 GB against a VRAM budget of 9.6 GB (VRAM minus about 2.4 GB), KV cache not included

pc-16gb.notes: 18.82 GB against a VRAM budget of 13.6 GB (VRAM minus about 2.4 GB), KV cache not included

pc-24gb.notes: 18.82 GB against a VRAM budget of 21.6 GB (VRAM minus about 2.4 GB), KV cache not included

pc-32gb.notes: 18.82 GB against a VRAM budget of 29.6 GB (VRAM minus about 2.4 GB), KV cache not included

mac-16-24gb.notes: 18.82 GB against a GPU share of about 12 GB (KV cache not included)

mac-32gb.notes: 18.82 GB against a GPU share of about 22 GB (KV cache not included)

mac-64gb+.notes: 18.82 GB against a GPU share of about 52 GB (KV cache not included)

benchmarks.name: 25 benchmarks across six domains, overall accuracy
ZoomGainBench, best of 28 evaluated models
benchmarks.variant: paper statement; ZoomGain-9B 'superior' on perception benchmarks, number not read

strengths: improves its base on every one of 25 benchmarks (vendor), including spatial reasoning and multimodal-agent tasks
weaknesses: research artifacts whose per-benchmark numbers are only in images
soft.maturity: ZwZ2 1.4k downloads, ZoomGain 1.6k; papers arXiv 2610.37037 and 2611.14076; earlier skipped as research artifacts, recorded after opening the cards

tona_fit.reason: Releasable fine-tunes of Qwen3.5-9B with a measurable perception gain, but no licence, no GGUF and a small gain over a base model we can already offer. Watch for a licence and a screenshot-focused evaluation.

open_questions: ZwZ2 27B and 4B base models and sizes
gain on screenshot and document benchmarks specifically
